The exact frozen v0.1.0-rc.3 commit 1e4e831b8248cc68a65d3ce11e5ec9000b91671f (deterministic archive SHA-256 3f52fa6c8d214d4e9db47ee53231eef9e394e1ed77eef88addd9e589fcb491b7) completed the versioned 900-second Linux amd64 Clang 18 ASan/UBSan/libFuzzer campaign with an available external symbolizer on the Expat 2.8.5 / system graph. The full log and evolved corpus remain privately retained and hash-bound. This is evidence for this exact build, not universal parser safety; final commit Y3 is re-qualified separately (ADR 0021).

Intentional public API changes require explicit baseline review; no ABI promise is made before 1.0.
